---
title: "Research"
---

My research addresses the design and optimization of intelligent wireless networks, especially where communication, sensing, mobility, and security meet.

## Integrated Sensing and Communications

ISAC systems use shared wireless infrastructure to communicate with users while sensing the surrounding environment. I investigate resource allocation, system design, and security-aware sensing/communication trade-offs.

## UAV-assisted wireless networks

I study aerial networks, including trajectory optimization, stochastic geometry, D2D-assisted UAV communication, UAV mobile edge computing, and cooperative UAV systems.

## RIS, FRIS, and intelligent radio environments

Reconfigurable surfaces provide new ways to shape wireless propagation. My work includes RIS-assisted NOMA, physical-layer authentication with simultaneous reflecting and sensing RIS, and optimization of intelligent wireless environments.

## Physical-layer security

This theme covers secure NOMA, secrecy-aware resource allocation, artificial-noise and friendly-jamming strategies, and authentication in future wireless systems.

## Optimization and signal processing

I develop practical methods based on block coordinate descent, successive convex approximation, semidefinite relaxation, convex-concave procedures, and learning-based signal processing.
